Independent verification read all five finalized xcresult bundles and reran the canonical minimum-count and required-test-manifest JSON checks for every suite.
All 386 test executions passed with no failures, skips or expected failures: 19 golden contracts, 124 Watch unit tests, 163 phone unit tests, 62 Watch UI tests and 18 phone UI tests.

The complete Watch UI manifest passed, including idle picker-before-start, paused reentry without resuming, warm reentry preserving paused time, all widget families and rectangular layout/privacy/localization matrices.

The complete iPhone UI manifest passed, including active/completion accessibility audits, timer persistence, companion conflict recovery, privacy opt-in, local-data confirmation and Live Activity error handling.
Toolchain evidence records XcodeGen 2.46.0 and Xcode 26.6; generated-project, source/privacy/localization gates, all four simulator/device build stages and unsigned release-product checks passed.

The fresh source and product provenance identify exactly 6c5f66f954ee3f891e4b7e438ecd4eba60d2fc29, tree 22e8d45f8c80c1205a6e0b153d8a1548cdf49978, version 0.2.0 build 6, and production manifest SHA256 9680ce4d31c8a523209d838b9afc72bff873d9b31479b2c38392545ed4509e72.
After completion, this verifier independently confirmed the frozen worktree is clean and every one of the 143 production source files still matches the CI source manifest.

The verifier only inspected completed outputs and wrote unique evidence artifacts; no tests were restarted and no build, source, simulator or device operations were performed by the verifier during this verification.

The deliberately interrupted run.cePXas remains retained and is not acceptance evidence. The subsequent clean restoration was independently verified; only fresh run.P0vsMs is marked as the passed full CI run here.
This is engineering and simulator evidence. The app-hosted widget rendering and DEBUG production-handler reentry harness do not prove real WidgetKit tap delivery or physical Watch behavior.

This receipt does not provide installed Home Screen light/dark/Auto icon observations, physical-device smoke, distribution export, upload validation, App Review or public-release evidence; signed-package evidence is separate ER-3.
Prior build 5 and earlier design CI receipts remain bound to their original commits and are not relabeled as build 6 results.
